items.title: Sister Bernice Phillips Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: They got to have his agent. Have to have it in statement correct. Josh.

ctx.x: I didn't leave anything. And you never had social security yourself? No.

But now the lady told my daughter. See they've been running down there trying to tend to it for me. That if they get him on full night and back I'll get social security too. They got to have his agent. Have to have it in statement correct. Josh. They are right.
